room_rent.display: Single Private Room (base); No Limit via optional add-on
room_rent.note: Base plan offers Single Private Room or 1% of SI/day depending on Policy Schedule. Optional Cover 16 (Room Rent Modification) can upgrade to No Limit.

icu.display: 2% of SI/day (base); No sub-limit via optional add-on
icu.note: Base plan caps ICU at 2% of SI/day. Optional Cover 16 removes the cap.

copayment.display: None (base); optional co-pay for age 61+ via Optional Cover 18
copayment.note: No mandatory co-pay in base plan. Optional Cover 18 introduces co-pay for insured aged 61+. Benefit 11 (Global Coverage excl. USA) has a mandatory 10% co-pay.

sub_limits.display: Cataract, knee replacement, hernia, hysterectomy, BPH, renal stones, cardio/cerebrovascular, cancer, renal complications, bone fractures — if specified in Policy Schedule
sub_limits.note: Sub-limits for named ailments/procedures apply only if specifically mentioned in the Policy Schedule. Amounts not stated in the wording itself.

deductible.display: None (base); optional aggregate deductible via Optional Cover 5
deductible.note: No deductible in base plan. Optional Cover 5 (Deductible Option) allows policyholder to choose a deductible for premium discount; applied on aggregate basis per policy year.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; not applicable for accidents or if continuously covered for more than 12 months.

ped_waiting.display: 36 months (reducible to 24 months via Optional Cover 12)
ped_waiting.note: Base PED waiting period is 36 months. Optional Cover 12 (Reduction in PED Wait Period) reduces it to 24 months at inception only.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Applies to listed conditions including cataract, hernia, joint replacement, BPH, kidney stones, varicose veins, Parkinson's/Alzheimer's, etc.

maternity.note: Benefit 15: Maternity Cover included in base plan with 24-month waiting period from first policy inception. Available only under floater cover for insured aged 18+. Limit as specified in Policy Schedule.

cumulative_bonus.display: Up to 50% (10%/yr base); up to 100% with NCB Super add-on
cumulative_bonus.note: Base No Claims Bonus: 10% per claim-free year, max 50% of base SI. Optional Cover 4 (NCB Super) adds 50%/yr up to 100% of SI. Bonus reduced by 10% (or 50% for NCB Super) on a claim year.

restoration.display: Once/year, 100% of base SI (same & different illness)
restoration.note: Benefit 7 (Automatic Recharge): reinstates base SI once per policy year after full exhaustion, for same or different illness. Optional Cover 3 (Unlimited Automatic Recharge) upgrades to unlimited restorations.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 30 days prior to admission for the same condition.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days after discharge for the same condition.

day_care.display: Listed day-care procedures (Annexure I — extensive list)
day_care.note: Day Care Treatment covered up to base SI for procedures listed in Annexure I. List is illustrative and not exhaustive; technological advancements may be included.

domiciliary.display: Covered (up to limit in Policy Schedule)
domiciliary.note: Benefit 6: Domiciliary Hospitalization covered via reimbursement for treatment lasting more than 3 consecutive days. Excludes 12 specified conditions (asthma, diabetes, hypertension, etc.).

ayush.note: Benefit 9: AYUSH (Ayurveda, Yoga, Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, Homeopathy) in-patient treatment covered up to base SI at registered AYUSH hospitals within India.

organ_donor.display: Covered (up to limit in Policy Schedule)
organ_donor.note: Benefit 5: Organ Donor Cover pays medical expenses of the donor for organ transplant surgery. Pre/post-hospitalisation for donor not covered.

ambulance.display: Covered up to base SI (road ambulance)
ambulance.note: Benefit 4: Road ambulance covered up to base SI for emergency transport to nearest hospital or inter-hospital transfer. Air ambulance available via Optional Cover 14.

modern_treatments.note: Clause 3.1.1(iv) lists 12 advanced technology methods including robotic surgery, stereotactic radiosurgery, oral chemotherapy, immunotherapy, stem cell therapy (haematopoietic), HIFU, deep brain stimulation, etc., covered up to base SI.

consumables.display: Not covered (non-medical items excluded per Annexure II)
consumables.note: Annexure II lists extensive non-medical/consumable items excluded. No inbuilt or optional consumables cover rider mentioned.

global_cover.display: Inbuilt (excl. USA); USA coverage via optional add-on
global_cover.note: Benefit 11: Global Coverage (excl. USA) inbuilt — 45 days/trip, 90 days/year, 10% mandatory co-pay. Benefit 14 (Care Anywhere) covers major illnesses globally up to base SI. Optional Cover 1 extends to USA. Optional Cover 17 (Global Plus) covers all inpatient globally with diagnosis in India.

moratorium.note: After 5 continuous years, no look-back applies except for proven fraud and permanent exclusions. Enhanced SI has its own 5-year moratorium from date of enhancement.

grace_period.note: Grace period is 30 days for annual/half-yearly/quarterly premium modes and 15 days for monthly mode. Coverage not available during grace period unless premium paid in instalments.

free_look.note: Free look period of 30 days from receipt of policy document for new policies only; not applicable on renewals or portability/migration.

portability.note: Portability to other insurers permitted as per IRDAI guidelines; must apply at least 30 days before renewal.

notable_exclusions.display: External congenital anomalies, RMO/surcharges, external prosthetics, refractive error <7.5D, non-allopathic (except AYUSH benefit), self-inflicted injury, tobacco/alcohol-related illness, advanced treatments not in Clause 3.1.1(iv)

optional_riders.display: Global Coverage–Total (USA), Travel Plus, Unlimited Recharge, NCB Super, Deductible Option, Everyday Care, Smart Select, OPD Care, Personal Accident, Accidental SI top-up, PED wait reduction (24mo), Air Ambulance, Room Rent Modification, Co-pay (age 61+), Loyalty Bonus
